plot-title: Norm source (explicit versus implicit) by corpus
plot-caption: We compare whether each norm is stated explicitly in the text or inferred implicitly from the scene. Both corpora are implicit-dominant (76.7% fiction10 versus 80.1% top100 implicit, and 19.5% versus 15.8% explicit), a small but consistent shift (Jensen-Shannon divergence, JSD = 0.002).
